name: Cucumber Gin Fizz

instructions.primary_message: In a cocktail shaker, muddle the cucumber slices with the lime juice and simple syrup until the cucumber has completely dissolved.

Fill the cocktail shaker with ice, add the gin and shake for about 10 seconds. Pour the cocktail through a mini strainer into a Collins glass filled with ice. Top with seltzer water and garnish with a cucumber slice.

schema_metadata.keywords: cucumber cocktail, cucumber cocktail recipe, cucumber fizz

description: This cucumber gin fizz is bright and refreshing—and tastes like summer in a glass.
notes:
Optional or for serving: 3 slices of cucumber, about 0.5-cm thick plus one for garnish

Notes: To make simple syrup, combine 1 cup water with 1 cup sugar in a small saucepan and heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sugar is dissolved. Cool before using.

Make-ahead and storage: Simple syrup will keep in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
author: Kelly Carámbula
